calculation.expression: state_t * -(close_t / close_{t-3} - 1), where state_t = 1 if cross-sectional median absolute daily-return deviation is above its trailing 60-day median, else 0; cross-sectionally demean across valid tradable assets
calculation.description: A short-horizon contrarian signal activated only when cross-asset return dispersion is elevated. All inputs are available through the prior completed day at decision time; the signal is intended for one-day forward return prediction.

validation.regime_notes: Positive IC and ICIR across reported periods: 2020-2022 mean IC 0.057174, 2023 0.043035, 2025 0.043298, and 2026-07 onward 0.032011. Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
